static_traits.name: Lin Kai
static_traits.social_status: Has several close friends to discuss personal issues with, but has not yet discussed unemployment and inferiority with them; relationships with colleagues deteriorated before leaving due to stress.
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological issues; never received psychotherapy; no significant physical illness.
static_traits.language_features: Clear and organized expression, able to notice and cooperatively discuss automatic thoughts; positive attitude, highly cooperative; able to express nervousness, anxiety and other emotions; willing to try homework and reality testing.

basic_info.main_problem: I was recently fired by a drone company, and I feel it is because they think I am not competent enough. Since then, my self-confidence has decreased, and I feel more anxious about future job opportunities.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these thoughts are affecting my self-esteem and stopping me from applying for new job opportunities.
growth_experiences: Felt overwhelmed while handling a highly complex, tight-deadline project at the drone company, and could not deliver on time; was then fired by the company. Stress was high when this happened, along with fear of failure; thoughts of 'I am not good enough' then appeared frequently (especially when applying for new positions), self-confidence decreased and anxiety about future job opportunities increased; relationships with colleagues deteriorated before leaving due to personal stress, and sleep and eating patterns became disordered after unemployment; although having several close friends, has not yet discussed unemployment and inferiority with them.

core_beliefs: I am not competent at work

special_situations.event: The situation of being fired by the drone company
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I miss project deadlines or underperform, it proves I am not good enough overall; if they think I am no good, then that is the fact
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids or delays applying for new jobs to avoid failing again and being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must think I am no good/I am not good enough

special_situations.event: In situations of submitting applications or browsing job postings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One failure means I will fail in the future too, and employers will all think I am not competent enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing or pausing job-seeking actions, prioritizing avoidance of applications to lower anxiety from uncertainty
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I may fail again; no one will hire me

special_situations.event: Facing highly complex projects with tight deadlines
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot deliver on time, it equals total failure and proves my ability is insufficient
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Intensifying self-doubt, over-focusing on mistakes, causing work performance to be further affected
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot do it/I will fail

special_situations.event: The phase of interacting with colleagues under increased stress
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I perform poorly, others will look down on me or distance themselves, which shows I am no good
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing direct communication, withdrawing in relationships to avoid being negated

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized, seen as competent, and to have stable career security
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and being negated, worrying about being fired again and a blocked future
defense_goal: Avoiding re-experiencing negation and failure by avoiding applying for new jobs, to protect self-esteem

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough failure prone to being negated

manifestations: Having several close friends but not yet discussing unemployment and inferiority with them
Deteriorated relationships with colleagues under increased stress, reduced direct communication

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequently expressing the self-evaluation of 'I am not good enough' in counseling
Excessively worrying about others' possible evaluations
Tending to attribute one failure wholesale to insufficient personal ability
Avoiding discussing related troubles with friends

exception_events.target_problem: When thinking about being fired and project failure, the client usually repeatedly engages in self-denial and avoids applying for new positions, causing job-seeking stagnation and further declining self-confidence.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Received positive feedback and was recognized as capable in previous other projects, which differs from the dominant narrative of 'I am not good enough', suggesting professional competence.
exception_events.reason: Clues: past success and the fact that teammates also found the project hard provide objective support for ability and external factors, weakening the narrative that attributes one failure wholesale to personal incompetence.

positive_force: Positive feedback in past projects shows professional ability and experience
Has several close friends who can provide emotional support
Able to identify and accept the impact of external factors (company restructuring and budget cuts) on the firing
negative_force: Cognitive biases of mind reading, predicting the future and black-and-white thinking
Sleep and eating problems caused by anxiety
Overly concerned with others' evaluations (seeking external validation)

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding / delaying applying for new jobs
antecedent: Thinking about being fired and project failure
When preparing to apply or browse job postings
target_behavior.core_reason: Fear of failure and being negated; cognitive biases of mind reading and predicting the future; overgeneralizing one mistake into overall incompetence
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential rejection and negative evaluation, briefly lowering anxiety to protect self-esteem
target_behavior.consequence: Stagnant job-seeking progress, hindered career development, further declining self-confidence, maintained anxiety

target_behavior.behavior: Disordered sleep and eating (difficulty falling asleep, irregular eating)
antecedent: When recalling project failure and job-seeking uncertainty
target_behavior.core_reason: Physiological and behavioral dysregulation triggered by high-pressure anxiety and self-denial
target_behavior.function: In the short term, escapes facing emotions and stress (stress response)
target_behavior.consequence: Declining physical energy and focus, intensified anxiety, further lowering job-seeking and self-efficacy

target_behavior.behavior: Elevated self-doubt and anxiety in high-pressure project situations, affecting work performance
target_behavior.core_reason: Black-and-white thinking treating on-time delivery as the sole standard of ability; emotional reasoning equating tense experiences with incompetence
target_behavior.function: Tries to 'force' oneself to perform through hypervigilance but triggers excessive pressure
target_behavior.consequence: Declining performance, deteriorating interpersonal relationships, increased risk of negative evaluation and firing
